StringListProperty.Description.sys:String: Specifies one or more directories to add to the include path; separate with semi-colons if more than one. (/I[path])
Specifies one or more directories (separate directory names with a semicolon) to be searched to resolve names passed to a #using directive. (/AI[path])

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: Specifies the type of debugging information generated by the compiler. You must also change linker settings appropriately to match. (/Z7, Zd, /Zi, /ZI)

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: Select the type of debugging information created for your program and whether this information is kept in object (.obj) files or in a program database (PDB).

Produces a program database (PDB) that contains type information and symbolic debugging information for use with the debugger. The symbolic debugging information includes the names and types of variables, as well as functions and line numbers.

EnumProperty.Name: CompileAsManaged
EnumProperty.Description: Use the .NET runtime service. This switch is incompatible with some other switches; see the documentation on the /clr family of switches for details.

EnumValue.Name: true
EnumValue.Description: Creates metadata for your application that can be consumed by other CLR applications, and allows your application to consume types and data in the metadata of other CLR components.

EnumValue.Name: Pure
EnumValue.DisplayName: Pure MSIL Common Language RunTime Support
EnumValue.Description: Produces an MSIL-only output file with no native executable code, although it can contain native types compiled to MSIL.

EnumValue.Name: Safe
EnumValue.DisplayName: Safe MSIL Common Language RunTime Support
EnumValue.Description: Produces an MSIL-only (no native executable code) and verifiable output file.

EnumValue.Name: OldSyntax
EnumValue.DisplayName: Common Language RunTime Support, Old Syntax
EnumValue.Description: Enables Managed Extensions for C++ syntax, the original Visual C++ syntax for CLR programming.

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Suppresses the display of the sign-on banner when the compiler starts up and display of informational messages during compiling.

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: Select how strict you want MIDL to be about code errors. (/W0 - /W4)

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: Level 0 disables all warnings.
Level 1 displays severe warnings. Level 1 is the default warning level at the command line.
Level 2 displays all level 1 warnings and warnings less severe than level 1.
Level 3 displays all level 2 warnings and all other warnings recommended for production purposes.
Level 4 displays all level 3 warnings plus informational warnings, which in most cases can be safely ignored.
Enables all warnings, including those disabled by default.

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Treats all compiler warnings as errors. For a new project, it may be best to use /WX in all compilations; resolving all warnings will ensure the fewest possible hard-to-find code defects.
Multi-processor Compilation

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: Select option for code optimization; choose Custom to use specific optimization options. (/Od, /O1, /O2, /Ox)

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: Disable optimization.
Equivalent to /Og /Os /Oy /Ob2 /Gs /GF /Gy
Equivalent to /Og /Oi /Ot /Oy /Ob2 /Gs /GF /Gy
Equivalent to /Og /Oi /Ot /Oy /Ob2

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: Select the level of inline function expansion for the build. (/Ob1, /Ob2)

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: Disables inline expansion, which is on by default.
Expands only functions marked as inline, __inline, __forceinline or __inline or, in a C++ member function, defined within a class declaration.
Expands functions marked as inline or __inline and any other function that the compiler chooses (expansion occurs at the compiler's discretion, often referred to as auto-inlining).

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Enables intrinsic functions. Using intrinsic functions generates faster, but possibly larger, code. (/Oi)

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: Whether to favor code size or code speed; 'Global Optimization' must be turned on. (/Ot, /Os)

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: Favor Small Code. Minimizes the size of EXEs and DLLs by instructing the compiler to favor size over speed.
Favor Fast Code. Maximizes the speed of EXEs and DLLs by instructing the compiler to favor speed over size. (This is the default.)
No size nor speed optimization.

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Enables memory space optimization when using fibers and thread local storage access. (/GT)
Enables cross-module optimizations by delaying code generation to link time; requires that linker option 'Link Time Code Generation' be turned on. (/GL)

StringListProperty.Description.sys:String: Defines a preprocessing symbols for your source file.
Specifies one or more preprocessor undefines. (/U[macro])

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Undefine all previously defined preprocessor values. (/u)
Prevents the compiler from searching for include files in directories specified in the INCLUDE environment variables.
Preprocesses C and C++ source files and writes the preprocessed output to a file. This option suppresses compilation, thus it does not produce an .obj file.

StringProperty.Description.sys:String: Specify the output path for the preprocesser. The default location is the same as the source file(s).

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Preprocess without #line directives.
Suppresses comment strip from source code; requires that one of the 'Preprocessing' options be set. (/C)

Enables the compiler to create a single read-only copy of identical strings in the program image and in memory during execution, resulting in smaller programs, an optimization called string pooling. /O1, /O2, and /ZI automatically set /GF option.
Enables minimal rebuild, which determines whether C++ source files that include changed C++ class definitions (stored in header (.h) files) need to be recompiled.

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: Specifies the model of exception handling to be used by the compiler.

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: The exception-handling model that catches asynchronous (structured) and synchronous (C++) exceptions (/EHa)
The exception-handling model that catches C++ exceptions only and tells the compiler to assume that extern C functions never throw a C++ exception. (/EHsc)
The exception-handling model that catches C++ exceptions only and tells the compiler to assume that extern C functions do throw an exception. (/EHs)
No exception handling.

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Enable checking for conversion to smaller types, incompatible with any optimization type other than debug. (/RTCc)

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: Perform basic runtime error checks, incompatible with any optimization type other than debug. (/RTCs, /RTCu, /RTC1)

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: Enables stack frame run-time error checking
Reports when a variable is used without having been initialized.
Equivalent of /RTCsu
Default runtime checks.
Causes your application to use the multithread, static version of the run-time library.
Defines _DEBUG and _MT. This option also causes the compiler to place the library name LIBCMTD.lib into the .obj file so that the linker will use LIBCMTD.lib to resolve external symbols.
Causes your application to use the multithread- and DLL-specific version of the run-time library. Defines _MT and _DLL and causes the compiler to place the library name MSVCRT.lib into the .obj file.

Defines _DEBUG, _MT, and _DLL and causes your application to use the debug multithread- and DLL-specific version of the run-time library. It also causes the compiler to place the library name MSVCRTD.lib into the .obj file.

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: Specifies 1, 2, 4, or 8-byte boundaries for struct member alignment. (/Zp[num])

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: Packs structures on 1-byte boundaries. Same as /Zp.
Packs structures on 2-byte boundaries.
Packs structures on 4-byte boundaries.
Packs structures on 8-byte boundaries (default).
Packs structures on 16-byte boundaries.
Default alignment settings.

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Check for buffer overruns; useful for closing hackable loopholes on internet servers. The default is enabled. (/GS-)
Allows the compiler to package individual functions in the form of packaged functions (COMDATs). Required for edit and continue to work. (/Gy)

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: Improves the consistency of floating-point tests for equality and inequality.

The strictest floating-point model. /fp:strict causes fp_contract to be OFF and fenv_access to be ON. /fp:except is implied and can be disabled by explicitly specifying /fp:except-. When used with /fp:except-, /fp:strict enforces strict floating-point semantics but without respect for exceptional events.
Creates the fastest code in the majority of cases.

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Reliable floating-point exception model. Exceptions will be raised immediately after they are triggered. (/fp:except)
Suppresses or enables language extensions. (/Za)

BoolProperty.DisplayName.sys:String: Treat WChar_t As Built in Type

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: When specified, the type wchar_t becomes a native type that maps to __wchar_t in the same way that short maps to __int16. /Zc:wchar_t is on by default.

BoolProperty.DisplayName.sys:String: Force Conformance in For Loop Scope

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Used to implement standard C++ behavior for the for statement loops with Microsoft extensions (/Za, /Ze (Disable Language Extensions)). /Zc:forScope is on by default.
Adds code for checking C++ object types at run time (runtime type information). (/GR, /GR-)
Enable OpenMP 2.0 language extensions. (/openmp)

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: Specifies how to use the auto keyword to declare variables. The default option /Zc:auto specifies the compiler deduces the type of the declared variable. /Zc:auto- specifies the compiler allocates the variable to the automatic storage class.

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: Specifies the compiler allocates the variable to the automatic storage class.
Specifies the compiler deduces the type of the declared variable from its initialization expression.

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: Create/Use Precompiled Header : Enables creation or use of a precompiled header during the build. (/Yc, /Yu)

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: Instructs the compiler to create a precompiled header (.pch) file that represents the state of compilation at a certain point.
Instructs the compiler to use an existing precompiled header (.pch) file in the current compilation.
Not using precompiled headers.

StringProperty.Description.sys:String: Specifies header file name to use when creating or using a precompiled header file. (/Yc[name], /Yu[name])
Specifies the path and/or name of the generated precompiled header file. (/Fp[name])

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Create listing file with expanded attributes injected into source file. (/Fx)

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: Specifies the contents of assembly language output file. (/FA, /FAc, /FAs, /FAcs)

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: No listing.
Assembly code; .asm
Machine and assembly code; .cod
Source and assembly code; .asm
Assembly, machine code and source code; .cod

StringProperty.Description.sys:String: Specifies relative path and/or name for ASM listing file; can be file or directory name. (/Fa[name])
Specifies a name to override the default object file name; can be file or directory name. (/Fo[name])
Specifies a name for a compiler-generated PDB file; also specifies base name for the required compiler-generated IDB file; can be file or directory name. (/Fd[name])
Specifies the name of the generated XML documentation files; can be file or directory name. (/doc[name])

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Enable Browse Information : Specifies level of browse information in .bsc file. (/FR)

StringProperty.Description.sys:String: Browse File : Specifies optional name for browser information file. (/FR[name])

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: Select compile language option for .c and .cpp files. (/TC, /TP)

EnumValue.Description.sys:String: Default.
Compile as C Code
Compile as C++ Code

StringListProperty.Description.sys:String: Disable the desired warning numbers; put numbers in a semi-colon delimited list. (/wd[num])
one or more forced include files. (/FI[name])
Specifies one or more forced #using files. (/FU[name])

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Generates a list of include files with compiler output. (/showIncludes)

BoolProperty.Name: EnablePREfast
BoolProperty.Description: Enables code analysis functionality that identifies common coding defects in C/C++ code. (/analyze)

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Use full paths in diagnostic messages. (/FC)
Do not include default library names in .obj files. (/Zl)

StringListProperty.Description.sys:String: Treats the specific compiler warning as an error where n is a compiler warning.

BoolProperty.Description.sys:String: Causes the output file to be created in UTF-8 format.

BoolProperty.Name: RegisterReservation
BoolProperty.Description: Allows a game title to reserve VMX registers from VR64 to VR95 for private use. Note that calls to Xbox 360 title libraries may not honor the reservation of these registers. (/QVMXReserve)

BoolProperty.Name: AnalyzeStalls
BoolProperty.Description: Produce a listing with cycle counts from pipeline emulations. This /FAcs option must be included or no .cod will be produced. (/QXSTALLS)

EnumProperty.Name: CallAttributedProfiling
EnumProperty.Description: Generates calls to profiler upon entering and exiting functions. (/fastcap, /callcap)

BoolProperty.Name: TrapIntegerDividesOptimization
BoolProperty.Description: Disables generation of trap instructions around integer divides. (/Oc)

BoolProperty.Name: PreschedulingOptimization
BoolProperty.Description: Performs an additional code scheduling pass before the register allocation phase. (/Ou)

BoolProperty.Name: InlineAssemblyOptimization
BoolProperty.Description: Allows the compiler to reorder inline assembly instructions, interleaving them into surrounding code to minimize latencies. (/Oz)

EnumProperty.Name: PREfast
EnumProperty.Description: Enables code analysis functionality that identifies common coding defects in C/C++ code. (/analyze, /analyze:only)

EnumValue.Name: Analyze
EnumValue.DisplayName: Enable static analysis in the build.

StringListProperty.Description.sys:String: Specifies one or more directories for which to disable code analysis warnings; use semi-colon delimited list if more than one. (/analyze:wdpath[path])
